note: Declared tables (not views) that an edge function reads and that nothing anywhere inserts into. Each is a question - who fills this in? - not a defect: the answer is usually a UI that was never built, an importer never wired, or an external feed that should be named in a comment. See scripts/check-unwritten-tables.mjs. Do not grow it. AUDIT-036 CHANGED WHAT SOME OF THESE MEAN. Six entries - contract_renewal_tracking, renewal_analytics, supply_monitoring, supply_replenishment_analytics, supply_usage_history and client_collected_metrics - were not merely unwritten: their tenant_id was integer against a uuid tenants.id (AUDIT-032, migration 0062) and their foreign keys were integer against uuid targets (AUDIT-036, migration 0063), so nothing COULD write them. Both are fixed, which means the question this file asks is now a real one for those six rather than a symptom. platform_bant_qualification is the newest entry and the cleanest example of the shape: supabase/functions/platform-deals/ reads it correctly for the BANT tab, the table and its columns are real, and no code anywhere inserts a row - so the tab is honestly empty rather than wrong.
